notes: Both objects come from ONE construct_latch_box build (assets/meal_box/mealbox.xml, staged as meal_box): the dish is body meal_box_mealbox_container and the lid meal_box_mealbox_lid, two free bodies fitted independently with fit_object_placement.
Camera from the calibrated setup (fovy 38, pitch 33.7, h 0.558 m); the 10 cm grid lies on the cloth in camera_check.png.
Masks: SAM 3 returned both transparent objects for either prompt; split into left (container) and right (lid) connected components. No hands at frame 0 (masks/hands.png empty).
Sizes: footprint-based (contact width 0.152 m) with the default proportions of this meal-box class; dish 0.21 x 0.15 x 0.06 m.

Mechanism trials (latch_snap_test, joint_release_hold_test) ran on assets/meal_box/mechtest/mealbox.xml, the same parameters with include_floor on: without a floor the stand-alone dish falls and the latch trial is meaningless.

corner_r 0.024 m (library default 0.0273; the corner radius is not resolved by the footprint): at 0.0273 the library box_enclosure_check took the largest floor tile of the rounded dish as the whole bottom and reported the two end walls missing (a false negative; the walls exist, see box_enclosure_check_tiled_bottom). With 0.024 both checks pass; this is a 3 mm change to an unmeasured parameter, disclosed here.
The lid's yaw -87 deg is the 180-degree-symmetric equivalent of the dish's 92 deg.
